FObjectInstancingGraph::GetInstancedComponent: outside the archetype and UCC-make paths the instance keeps the template's name, and anything already holding that name under the same outer is renamed away first (Rename(NULL, ComponentOuter, REN_ForceNoResetLoaders|REN_DoNotDirty)). UObjectProperty::InstanceValue: when the destination owner is not a template, the instanced sub-object keeps the source template's name unless the source already belongs to that owner. UObjectProperty::InstanceSubobjects: this tree already matches retail (it names only for a template owner). The defect was in InstanceValue, not here; checked before changing anything
